avoid_supplements.name: Bile acid sequestrants (Cholestyramine, Colesevelam)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Bile acid sequestrants reduce ezetimibe absorption by binding in the GI tract, decreasing drug efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Separate dosing by at least 2 hours; take ezetimibe before bile acid sequestrant

caution_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction may increase ezetimibe metabolism, potentially reducing efficacy
caution_supplements.action: Monitor lipid panel; consider alternative herbal products or increased ezetimibe monitoring

caution_supplements.name: Red Yeast Rice
caution_supplements.mechanism: Contains naturally occurring statins; additive LDL-lowering effect may increase myopathy risk when combined
caution_supplements.action: Educate patient on additive cholesterol-lowering effects; monitor for muscle symptoms

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase ezetimibe plasma concentrations, though clinical significance is minimal
caution_foods.action: Limit grapefruit consumption; monitor for increased adverse effects if high intake

monitoring_notes: Ezetimibe has minimal interactions due to modest CYP metabolism and primarily glucuronidation-based elimination. Monitor lipid levels 4-12 weeks after initiation or dosing changes, and assess for unexplained muscle pain/weakness, particularly if co-prescribed with statins.
